name: AgentGuard
description: AgentGuard: a local, read-only security check-up for Claude Code and Claude Desktop setups. One plugin (aguard) that audits what an agent auto-loads, vets a skill before you install it, and gates skill loads on a content hash.

plugins.name: aguard
plugins.description: A security check-up for your Claude setup. Say 'set up AgentGuard' to begin; after that, just ask: 'Is my Claude setup safe?', 'Is this skill safe to install?', 'Clean up my unused skills.' Everything runs on your machine; nothing is uploaded. Local, read-only security scan for AI agent environments: audit ~/.claude for prompt injection / credential exfiltration / over-broad permission grants, vet a skill before installing it, and gate skill loads on a canonical content hash.
